en:
I ain't really sure, but considerin'
what y'said Lo told ya...

...The kid's probly part o' somethin'
way bigger than he even knows.

I reckon it's possible the Yomei aren't
really goin' fer the boss, but fer the kid.
We just need to get to Hiroshima.

What about the rest of the family, though?
Are Matsunaga and Tagashira safe?

Yeah. They're hiding at Moreno
so the main family doesn't find 'em.

Moreno? Ain't that gonna be the first
place they go lookin' for the boss?

Those knuckleheads are gonna
get themselves caught.

You're right about that. And even if they
don't know where Hirose-san went...

...The Yomei Alliance isn't
really going to care.

Either way, our first stop is Moreno.
Get ready to leave Kamurocho, you two.

We're ready t'head back to Hiroshima
whenever y'wanna leave.

Jus' lemme know when
yer finished preppin'.

Aniki. Are y'ready fer our trip
back t'Hiroshima?

Yeah, I'm ready.
Let's go.
Gotcha. Jus' lemme know when yer ready.

Aniki. Y'oughta head over t'Moreno.
Matsunaga n' Tagashira're waitin' fer us.

But Cap, they said the main family is out
looking fer the boss all over town.

It's gonna be a real pain in the ass
if they catch us headin' that way.
We're past worrying about that now.

Damn straight.
If they're seriously tryin' t'stop us...
...We'll just hafta fight past 'em.

Nobody's gettin' in our way now,
not even the main family!

You! Stop right there
if y'know what's good fer ya!
Aniki. Those're main family guys.

So yer back, Kiryu. And y'got some
o' the Hirose brats with ya.

Gimme a second o' yer time.
I got a question fer ya.
Doesn't sound like you really want to talk.

Where's old man Hirose hidin'?
I'll beat the answer outta ya if I hafta.

We don't have time for you guys right now.
Some other time?

Y'old bastard...
We ain't fuckin' around!

Get 'em!
Don't let 'em escape!
Let's take 'em down!

They're over here!
They ain't gettin' away!

Kiryu-aniki.
We jus' gotta get t'Moreno.

We ain't gonna make it in time
if these dirtbags keep blockin' us.

Cap, Yuta!
Y'all okay?
'Course we are.

But all that stuff 'bout Tatsukawa
gettin' killed, n' that <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> thing...
It sounded real serious.

Tagashira n' I were
pretty damn worried.
Yer over here too, Kiyo-chan?

Yeah. Tagashira-kun mentioned you three
would be coming, so it only seemed right.
I'm so sorry, Kiryu-san.

I should have been taking care of Haruto,
yet I still let this happen...

Wh-What're y'talkin' about, Kiyo-chan?
Nobody's tryin' t'blame ya fer this.
I do gotta wonder what happened, though.

Did y'see the boss run off
with the kid yerself?

Why don't y'take a seat first?
This could be a while, eh?

It was getting late, right as I was
getting ready to open the bar.

That's when Patriarch Hirose dropped by.
He said he wanted to see Haruto-kun.

I didn't really think much of it, since he
does stop by my bar every so often.
Haruto-kun looked so happy.

Right as he sat down to his drink,
he asked if I had any cigarettes.
I was fresh out, though.

So, I left Haruto-kun with him for
a little bit and ran to the store.

And when y'got back t'the bar,
he was gone, huh?
Is that all?

At first, I thought he had probably just
taken Haruto-kun out for a walk.

But, he had left some money on
the counter for his drink.

I tried calling him too, but he'd
left his phone at the bar as well.

I couldn't really believe
what was happening at the time.

But for as long as I waited,
your boss never came back.

That's when I called Matsunaga-san
and asked him to contact Yuta-kun.
Was the boss actin' weird or anythin'?

No, not at all. He was all smiles
and jokes, just like always.

If he paid for the drink, he must've
left by choice, not been taken by force.

In Kamurocho, I spoke to the
Saio Triad boss, Lo, about Haruto.
Lo gave me one vital clue...
He said Tatsukawa isn't Haruto's father.

He also mentioned that Haruto had some kind
of value to the crime war in Kamurocho.

We're thinkin' that's why Cap'n Koshimizu
wants the boss. He's really after the kid.
W-Wait a sec.

Maybe the boss's jus' hidin' Haruto so
nobody else can get at him.

In that case, he coulda at least clued
Kiyomi-san in on that.
He was probly tryin' to keep her outta it.

Still, we won't know anything until
we ask Patriarch Hirose ourselves.
We'll just have to find him first.

C'mon, boss!
Where the hell is Haruto!?
Um, Kiryu-san...
I'm so sorry for all of this.

We're only in this situation because I
didn't watch Haruto close enough.
No, you can't blame yourself.
But<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>

More importantly, there's something
I should probably tell you.
Someya and I fought again up in Kamurocho.

Even after that, I doubt that's the last
time we'll be encountering each other.
What made you fight, Kiryu-san?

Someya is responsible for putting
the Tojo Clan sixth chairman behind bars.

And the sixth chairman is a man
I personally brought into the yakuza fold.
He... means nothing to me now.
But, isn't he the father of your child?

I left her in Tokyo and ran away
from Someya years ago.

Honestly, I've been running my whole life.
I left this town just after high school.

I was so sick of how little this place had
to offer. That's how I ended up in Tokyo.

Once I got there, I started working
as a hostess at a fancy club.

Thanks to the bubble economy, my job in
Ginza made me the richest I'd ever been.

My Hiroshima roots gave way to
my sparkling new Tokyo identity.

And before I knew it, I was 30. My years in
the business gave me too much confidence.

That is, until I got mixed up
with a particularly bad customer.

He claimed to run a fancy real estate firm,
but he tricked me into a pile of debt.

He also said he'd get his yakuza friend
to come after me if I didn't pay.
Let me guess, that yakuza was Someya?

No, not quite. Someya was actually the
one who protected me from them.
He was another one of my customers.

When he saw me falling into massive
debt at the hands of that realtor...

...He risked his life behind the scenes
to settle things with those yakuza.

Kiyo-chan... I didn't realize you
n' Someya had that kinda history.

I'm sure your image of me
has changed, Nagumo-kun.

I'm just a fool who abandoned this town,
went to Tokyo, and got herself scammed.

Soon after Someya saved me,
we married and had a daughter together.
But my life with him was terrifying.

I asked him countless times to quit the yakuza
for our daughter's sake, but he never listened.

And if I dared ask about his day, he'd just
yell at me for prying into his business.

Things continued like that until one particular
night I was washing blood off his clothes.

When I looked over and saw him using
those hands to play with our daughter...
...I just couldn't bear it anymore!

So, I decided to take our daughter and run
away in the middle of the night.
But Someya was ready, huh?

Exactly. It was like he knew
my every thought.

One of his subordinates caught us. And after
taking our daughter back, Someya hit me.
Again. And again.
That monster!

Eventually, I had to leave my three-year-old
daughter behind to escape Someya.

He put a security detail on her so I'd
never have a chance to grab her.

I don't know anything about her now.
I couldn't tell you if she's happy or not.

Every day of my life I regret abandoning
her with that horrible man.

But given the circumstances,
what other choice did I have!?

Leaving her with the savage I'd
married was the only way <font_kind=yakuza_italic>I</font_kind> could survive.

Shouldn't you follow her, Nagumo?
We'll be okay. Go after her.
Nah, I can't do that.

Fer now, we gotta focus on findin' the boss.
The safety o' that kid is our top priority.

'Sides, with Hirose gone,
the cap's in charge o' the family.

Hey, uh, Cap.
I've been thinkin'...

Well, we ain't gonna solve nothin'
if we jus' sit around here like this.
Why don't we hit up some of his ol' joints?

Let's jus' think of a few places t'head to.
We can ask around there fer clues.
Do you have any ideas, Matsunaga?
Well, one or two.
Can y'guys think of anywhere?
Sure, I could come up with somethin'.

Kiryu-aniki. I think I might know
where the boss headed.
Can we check the office real quick?
You mean the Hirose Family office?

That ain't half bad, but why would he
be there? It's all locked up right now.

The boss doesn't even have a key,
so no way he'd be there.
Oh yeah. I forgot about that.

I guess there's always someone
there when he comes home.

Besides, the main family is
combin' the town for him.

If he was jus' chillin' in the office,
they'd have caught 'im hours ago.
So, any other good ideas?

Sorry, Kiryu-aniki.
Lemme think a bit more.

Oh, right.
How 'bout the Apollo Café?
The Apollo?

Hirose-san goes there t'get
takeout all the time.

If I had t'guess, I'd say the owner there
probly knows somethin' about him.

The Apollo's over in the shoppin' district.
Y'might wanna go check it out.

Hold up, didn't Hirose-san leave
his phone over at Kiyo-chan's bar?

Y'might be able t'find some clues
if y'take a peek in his call history.

Let's ask Kiyo-chan once
she's back in the bar.
Um... Maybe he's at the cemetery?

It's hard t'see past the walls,
n' people don't really go too often.

You're right. There's barely ever
anyone there when I stop by.
Probly worth a look.

Kiryu-aniki. Are you headin' out?
Let us come with you.

Those main family guys're probably
still crawling around out there.

No, I'll be fine alone. You guys keep
working on finding your boss.
But it's too dangerous t'go by yerself!

I'll be fine. Besides, you guys are
actually part of the Yomei Alliance.

Don't piss them off more 
than you already have.
(I should go to the places they mentioned...)

Pardon me.
Are you the owner of this café?
I am. D'you need something?

Have you seen Hirose-san
around here recently?
Hm? You a friend o' his?
Yeah, you could say that.

I haven't seen him 'round today.
Did somethin' bad happen?

No, nothing in particular.
I just need to talk to him.

Maybe he's out wanderin' the town?
He does that all the time.
Oh, I jus' remembered.
Hm? What is it?

Tell Hirose-san t'come n'
pay his tab from last month!

Seriously. If y'don't get on his case,
that fool don't pay for nothin'.
Okay, will do.

(It looks like he hasn't been here.
I should check somewhere else...)
Mama. Do you still have Hirose-san's phone?

Yeah. It's right there on the counter
where he left it.
I'm going to take a look, then.

(Doesn't look like he set up a password.
I'll just look at the call log.)
(Hm, this is the number for Kiyomi's bar.)

(That must be when she called him
after he went missing.)
(Wait, that's the only call in the whole log.)

(There's nothing else on here.
Even the address book is empty...)
Did you learn anything?
No, not a thing.
Did Hirose-san get this phone recently?
No, he's had it for some time now.

But now that I think about it, he
wipes it to factory settings pretty often.

He said he doesn't want to risk people
knowing all the trouble he gets into.

(Hirose-san's phone didn't turn up anything.
Maybe I should look somewhere else...)
(This is the cemetery Tagashira mentioned.)

(It doesn't seem like Hirose-san is here.
I should look somewhere else...)

(The lights are on, but the door is locked.
It doesn't look like anyone's home.)
(Hm? Hirose-san's window is open.)

(Why would Hirose-san take Haruto
without even telling anyone?)
(Maybe there are some clues in here.)
(What's this picture?)

(Wait, that's Chairman Kurusu
standing next to Hirose-san.)

(Now that I think about it, Hirose-san
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>did</font_kind> fight against the Omi back in the day.)

(Are the two of them more
connected than we realized?)

(Maybe the kidnapping was an
order from Chairman Kurusu...)

(No, I shouldn't make assumptions like
that based on just one picture.)

(It's a box of matches from
one of the bars in town.)
(Snack Hourglass... I bet it's close by.)

(He must go there often if he has this.
I should head over there next.)

So this is where y'been hangin' around, Kiryu.
Y'got guts comin' here all by yerself.
You must be Yomei men.
Where's old man Hirose at?

Is he the one you want? Or are
you actually looking for the baby?

If y'don't wanna tell us, we're jus'
gonna have t'force it outta ya.
It's time t'settle this, Kiryu.

Let's see what the Dragon o' Dojima
can do! Bring it on!

Wh-What the hell...?
How'd y'beat all of us?
